confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (hostel, hotel) and cocktail prices are less certain because July rates vary widely by season, venue, and booking lead time. FX: the 2026-10-15 observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page, not a direct page read, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Spain's mid-sized Canary Islands and Atlantic coastal cities, principally Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, with Spanish mainland provincial capitals as secondary reference. Santa Cruz is a working capital with less resort pricing than the south of Tenerife, so anchors sit between local-city and resort-town levels. Drinks anchors follow the typical Spanish relationship of beer to wine and cocktail prices.
